"""CPU-only paired scan experiment with exact output/state/history comparison."""
import ctypes,hashlib,json,statistics,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from tinygrad import Device
from tinygrad.device import TinyELF
from tinygrad.llm.kernels.rockchip_cpu import _renderer

S=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
report={'complete':False,'scope':'CPU scan primitive only; no model speed claim','cases':[],
        'sources':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (S/'control.c',S/'candidate.c')}}
output=S/'results.json'
renderer=_renderer();cpu=Device['CPU']
programs={label:cpu.runtime(TinyELF(renderer.compiler.compile_cached((S/(label+'.c')).read_text()),
          'cpu_gated_delta_scan',renderer.target,())) for label in ('control','candidate')}
for prg in programs.values():prg.fxn.restype=ctypes.c_int
def save():output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
rng=np.random.default_rng(8271026)
try:
 for rows,heads,kdim,vdim,adim in [(128,16,128,128,1),(1,16,128,128,1),(7,4,17,32,17),(7,4,17,16,1),(7,4,17,9,17)]:
  capacity=rows+1 if rows<128 else rows
  q=rng.normal(0,.04,(heads,capacity,kdim)).astype(np.float32)
  k=rng.normal(0,.04,q.shape).astype(np.float32)
  v=rng.normal(0,.1,(heads,capacity,vdim)).astype(np.float32)
  beta=rng.uniform(.1,.8,(heads,capacity)).astype(np.float32)
  alpha=rng.uniform(.65,.98,(heads,capacity,adim)).astype(np.float32)
  initial=rng.normal(0,.04,(heads,vdim,kdim)).astype(np.float32)
  state={l:initial.copy() for l in programs};out={l:np.empty_like(v) for l in programs}
  history={l:np.full((rows,heads,vdim,kdim),np.nan,np.float32) for l in programs} if rows<=8 else None
  def invoke(label,start):
   args=[out[label],q,k,v,beta,alpha,state[label]]
   ptrs=[ctypes.c_void_p(x.ctypes.data) for x in args]
   dims=[ctypes.c_int(x) for x in (start,rows,1,heads,capacity,kdim,vdim,adim)]
   hp=ctypes.c_void_p(history[label].ctypes.data) if history else ctypes.c_void_p()
   assert programs[label].fxn(*ptrs,*dims,hp)==0
  c={'rows':rows,'heads':heads,'key_dim':kdim,'value_dim':vdim,'alpha_dim':adim,'exact':[],
     'times_ns':{'control':[],'candidate':[]}}
  report['cases'].append(c)
  for start in (0,5,5,0):
   for label in programs:state[label][:]=initial;invoke(label,start)
   for collection in (out,state,*([history] if history else [])):
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(collection['control'].view(np.uint32),collection['candidate'].view(np.uint32))
   c['exact'].append({'start':start,'outputs_and_state':True,'history':history is not None})
  for _ in range(3):
   for label in programs:invoke(label,0)
  for block in range(40):
   for label in (('control','candidate','candidate','control') if block%2==0 else ('candidate','control','control','candidate')):
    start=time.perf_counter_ns();invoke(label,0);c['times_ns'][label].append(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)
  a,b=c['times_ns']['control'],c['times_ns']['candidate']
  ratios=[statistics.mean(a[i:i+2])/statistics.mean(b[i:i+2]) for i in range(0,len(a),2)]
  c['paired_speedup_median']=statistics.median(ratios);c['paired_blocks_faster']=sum(x>1 for x in ratios)
  c['median_ms']={l:statistics.median(t)/1e6 for l,t in c['times_ns'].items()};c['complete']=True
  save();print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in c.items() if k not in ('times_ns','exact')}),flush=True)
 report['complete']=True
finally:save()
